title: Command the battle, not the screen
summary: A quieter battle screen: orders show as you give them and then step aside, rest the cursor on a squad to see how it's doing, radio traffic comes over a command net, and a doctrine tree takes you from light vehicles to tanks, gunships and a patrol ship.
rationale: A layout change: matched before/after stills of the same moment show what left the screen; stills of the hover card, the doctrine tree and the command net show what replaced it.
source_ref: Before: 7e924ba2. After: this branch. Comparison and hover: --mission=bridgehead --play --autoplay --seed=2 --follow=0 --zoom=75 (hover 60) --pitch=-55 --shot-at=40 [--hover=squad] --perf=0. Doctrine: --scenario=showroom --play --team=0 --hud-panel=doctrine --research=armor,grenades,medicine,c_mech,c_aviation,c_riverine --research-q=c_armour,c_attack_aviation --shot-at=12. Command net: --host --team=0 --bot-cmds --select-all --shot-at=5.5. Forward+, off-screen windowed runs on Windows, 1600x900.
